author: Alan murphy3329

title: HIGHLY Recommended!
body: What a beautiful app. The simplicity of it is what makes it beautiful. The colour code using green and red to mark whether you did or did not complete your goal. And grey to represent a skipped day. For example. You were sick that day and you couldn't make it to the gym. You don't have to feel bad by giving yourself a red box. Because it's not your fault you can't go. Mark it as skipped. And if you want. You can even write a note in that box saying I was sick today. And I love that you can create any, and endless amount of goals/habits. And it gives you ideas on what to make as a good or bad goals/habits. Which I think are all great ideas. And of course I can't leave without mentioning the amazing chart breakdown. To see your progress over time like that is priceless. This app really is the app to keep you on track. Whether it is to keep you motivated to keep your gym sessions consistent or kick that bad habit of smoking. This app is for everyone. It will be one of the few apps that will earn its way to your main screen of your phone.
